title: VLLR: Cursed Villager
description: VLLR: Cursed Villager - this mod for new creepy villager and his events
body:
Vllr – the Cursed Villager
A strange and terrifying villager lurks in the shadows… Vllr is no ordinary NPC. He brings chaos and horror wherever he appears.

What can Vllr do?
- "Error Chunks" – corrupts the world in mysterious ways.
- Teleportation – drags you to his eerie house against your will.
- Aggression – will attack without warning.
- Summoning – spawns other villagers to aid him.
- Manipulation – sends messages in chat.
- Curses – applies random status effects to weaken you
- World Distortion – spawns eerie structures of cobwebs and red torches.
- And much more…
Can you survive Vllr’s curse?

Download the mod and uncover the horrors yourself… If you dare.
